verdict.rationale: BILL documents record export for vendors, customers, bills, invoices, and AP/AR payments, and a CSV import/export path to accounting software. The v3 API also covers Spend & Expense transactions and reimbursements, so data can be pulled programmatically. However, the export docs are AP/AR-focused, and nothing shows a complete, one-step export of Spend & Expense data in an open format. Missing for 10: explicit Spend & Expense export (card transactions, receipts, budgets), confirmation of the export file format, a complete account-wide export or offboarding path, and independent corroboration.
